answer: Anchor each identity to a domain the applicant controls. The registry issues a token to publish as a TXT record at _ivory under the applicant's own domain in a day, plus a transfer-lock check against fresh flips. Passing domains enter tundra status: frozen a year, barred from a second identity, any transfer flags the identity. The haven rule bars shared shelter: registrar checks catch one owner behind many names. Forging 1,000 sockpuppets needs 1,000 domains at about $10 a year each, about $10,000 a year, no bulk discount, while an honest agent reuses its own domain for $0 extra.
